name: Research
summary: Track questions, sources, findings, and open uncertainty.
firstAgentPrompt: Interview the operator about the research question, audience, evidence standard, scope, deadlines, and known sources. Turn that into a research plan, distinguish evidence from inference, and record citations in ordinary files.
additionalAgentPrompt: Read QUESTION.md, SOURCES.md, FINDINGS.md, OPEN-QUESTIONS.md, and AGENTS.md. Declare the sub-question you will investigate and keep source-backed findings separate from inference.
